description: Defines data structures and counters for RRC (Radio Resource Control) metrics, including connection counters with causes, resume counters, and overall metrics as per 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: rrc_connection_counter_with_cause
classes.description: Tracks RRC connection attempts and successes indexed by establishment cause.

classes.name: rrc_connection_resume_counter_with_cause
classes.description: Tracks RRC connection resume attempts and successes indexed by resume cause.

classes.name: rrc_du_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates various RRC connection and resume metrics, including counts and counters with causes.

methods.name: increase
methods.description: Increments the counter for a given cause, or 'unknown' if cause is out of range.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the counters array.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Retrieves the count for a specific cause or index.

methods.name: get_cause
methods.description: Returns the cause corresponding to a given index.
